milestones.text: played their first full scale without looking at their hands
milestones.post: One whole scale. Eyes up. Tiny victory.

milestones.text: practised every day for a whole week for the first time
milestones.post: Seven days in a row. Who even am I.

milestones.text: learned to read the first line of a simple tune
milestones.post: The dots are starting to mean something.

milestones.text: figured out how to tune {hobby} without help
milestones.post: Tuned it myself. It even sounds right.

milestones.text: played a simple folk tune slowly but correctly
milestones.post: Slow, but every note was the right one.

milestones.text: finally got through their first lesson without apologising once
milestones.post: Zero apologies this lesson. Growth.

milestones.text: worked out the first few notes of a tune by ear
milestones.post: Picked out a melody by ear. Felt like magic.

milestones.text: practised long enough that the neighbours started humming along
milestones.post: The neighbours know the tune now. Sorry, neighbours.

milestones.text: played a whole song start to finish without stopping
milestones.post: A whole song. No stopping. Small win.

milestones.text: kept steady time through an entire piece
milestones.post: Didn't rush once. Well, almost once.

milestones.text: learned five tunes well enough to play them on request
milestones.post: Five songs in the pocket now. Ask me for one.

milestones.text: played for a couple of friends after supper
milestones.post: Played for friends. Nobody left. Good sign.

milestones.text: sight-read a short new piece on the first try
milestones.post: First try on a new piece. Not pretty, but there.

milestones.text: got through a fast passage that had stumped them for weeks
milestones.post: That run finally fell into place.

milestones.text: noticed they could play a tune and hum along at the same time
milestones.post: Playing and humming at once. Brain upgrade.

milestones.text: played a duet with their teacher and kept up
milestones.post: Kept up with my teacher. Mostly.

milestones.text: joined a small group of players for a regular weekly session
milestones.post: Got a weekly session with real musicians now.

milestones.text: learned a piece fully by heart
milestones.post: Memorised the whole thing. No sheet needed.

milestones.text: played at a friend's party and got asked for an encore
milestones.post: They wanted another one. I only had one more.

milestones.text: improvised a little melody that actually sounded good
milestones.post: Made something up and it wasn't bad at all.

milestones.text: worked out a harmony part to a tune they knew
milestones.post: Found the harmony on my own. Lovely.

milestones.text: played a slow piece with real feeling for the first time
milestones.post: Played it like I meant it this time.

milestones.text: learned a tune from another player just by listening
milestones.post: Learned it by ear from a friend. Old-school.

milestones.text: got through a whole evening of playing without losing their place
milestones.post: A whole evening and I never got lost.

milestones.text: played a short solo spot at a community gathering
milestones.post: Played solo for a room full of people. Hands shook. It went fine.

milestones.text: started showing a beginner the basics of {hobby}
milestones.post: Teaching someone else now. Strange and lovely.

milestones.text: played at a local festival with their group
milestones.post: Festival day. Tired and happy.

milestones.text: wrote their first complete original tune
milestones.post: Wrote a tune. It has a name and everything.

milestones.text: played a full set without a single sheet of music
milestones.post: No sheets, no panic, whole set.

milestones.text: was asked to fill in for a missing player at short notice
milestones.post: Last-minute stand-in. Pulled it off.

milestones.text: took part in a small music competition and placed respectably
milestones.post: Didn't win, didn't embarrass myself. Proud.

milestones.text: played a wedding tune for a friend's celebration
milestones.post: Played at a friend's wedding. Nobody cried at my mistakes.

milestones.text: won first place in the local music competition
milestones.post: First place. Still can't quite believe it.

milestones.text: played the featured solo at the big seasonal concert
milestones.post: The solo was mine tonight. What a night.

milestones.text: was paid to play at an event for the first time
milestones.post: Got paid to play. Actual money.

milestones.text: had one of their own tunes picked up and played by other musicians
milestones.post: Heard someone else play my tune. Wild.

milestones.text: led the whole group through a concert as the front player
milestones.post: Led the band tonight. Didn't fall apart.

milestones.text: played a demanding concert piece all the way through, cleanly
milestones.post: The hard one. Clean. Start to finish.

milestones.text: was asked to give lessons by a neighbour's family
milestones.post: Have my own student now. Feels serious.

milestones.text: played a full evening's concert of their own
milestones.post: A whole concert. My name on the notice.

milestones.text: recorded themselves playing on their phone and actually liked it
milestones.post: Listened back to my own recording. Not cringing. Huge.

milestones.text: posted a clip of their playing online and got kind comments
milestones.post: Strangers said nice things. Internet, you surprise me.

milestones.text: followed a beginner video lesson all the way to the end
milestones.post: Finished the whole video lesson. Paused it forty times.

milestones.text: played a set at a café's open stage night
milestones.post: Café gig. Two people clapped very hard. Loved it.

milestones.text: learned their first three chords and switched between them
milestones.post: G, C, D. That's half of all songs, right?

milestones.text: stopped the strings buzzing on their first chord
milestones.post: No buzz! Clean chord! Finally!

milestones.text: learned their first barre chord, after a week of buzzing strings
milestones.post: F major, you are mine now.

milestones.text: strummed a steady rhythm through a whole campfire song
milestones.post: Kept the strum going for the whole song.

milestones.text: learned a fingerpicking pattern and played a ballad with it
milestones.post: Fingerpicking unlocked. Fingers confused but happy.

milestones.text: backed a singer for a whole evening on guitar
milestones.post: Played guitar for a singer all night. Felt like a real band.

milestones.text: played a flashy guitar solo at a packed local show
milestones.post: That solo got a cheer. Still buzzing.

milestones.text: played guitar on the porch until half the street came by to listen
milestones.post: Porch concert. Half the town showed up.

milestones.text: kept rhythm guitar going through a whole night at a dance hall
milestones.post: Strummed till the dancers gave up. Not me.

milestones.text: learned a song from an online guitar tab
milestones.post: Tabs online taught me a whole song tonight.

milestones.text: locked in with a simple drum beat for a whole minute
milestones.post: A whole minute in the pocket. Bass life.

milestones.text: learned to play a root note on every beat of a song
milestones.post: Root notes. Simple. Important. Me.

milestones.text: learned their first walking bass line
milestones.post: Walking bass. It walks! I walk!

milestones.text: played a slap bass groove without fumbling
milestones.post: Slap bass. Neighbours have feelings about it.

milestones.text: played bass with a band for a full rehearsal without getting lost
milestones.post: Full rehearsal, never lost. Bass player of the year.

milestones.text: played the bass solo everyone talked about after the show
milestones.post: Bass solo. People noticed the bass. Historic.

milestones.text: learned a famous bass line note for note
milestones.post: That famous riff, note for note. Grinning.

milestones.text: played a simple melody with both hands together
milestones.post: Both hands at once. My brain is sweating.

milestones.text: learned where middle C is without counting keys
milestones.post: Middle C, found instantly. Progress.

milestones.text: played Für Elise's opening section all the way through
milestones.post: Für Elise, the famous bit. Done.

milestones.text: played Clair de Lune all the way through
milestones.post: Clair de Lune. Start to finish. Sat in silence after.

milestones.text: played the piano at a friend's gathering while everyone sang
milestones.post: Played while everyone sang. Best kind of noise.

milestones.text: performed a Chopin nocturne at a small recital
milestones.post: Chopin at a recital. Nobody coughed during the quiet bit.

milestones.text: played a ragtime piece at full speed
milestones.post: Ragtime at full tilt. Hands still twitching.

milestones.text: played the piano for the evening's parlour entertainment
milestones.post: Parlour duty tonight. The guests stayed for more.

milestones.text: got through a whole hymn without a wrong chord
milestones.post: One hymn, zero wrong chords.

milestones.text: drew their first long bow stroke without a squeak
milestones.post: No squeak. Just a note. Beautiful.

milestones.text: learned to hold the bow properly for a whole lesson
milestones.post: Bow hold held. For an entire hour.

milestones.text: played their first tune with vibrato
milestones.post: Vibrato! It wobbles on purpose now.

milestones.text: played in a small string group for the first time
milestones.post: String group. I'm second violin and loving it.

milestones.text: played a Vivaldi movement at a community concert
milestones.post: Vivaldi at the concert. Didn't lose my nerve.

milestones.text: played the violin solo at the town's big concert
milestones.post: Solo violin tonight. My hands are still shaking.

milestones.text: kept their violin in tune through a whole session
milestones.post: Stayed in tune all session. Rare event.

milestones.text: scraped out their first recognisable jig on the fiddle
milestones.post: It was a jig. You could tell. Mostly.

milestones.text: played the fiddle for a dance and kept the dancers going
milestones.post: They kept dancing. That means it worked.

milestones.text: learned a reel by ear from an old fiddler
milestones.post: Learned a reel by ear from the best fiddler around.

milestones.text: fiddled through a whole barn dance with the band
milestones.post: Barn dance, all night. Arms are done.

milestones.text: won the fiddle contest at the harvest fair
milestones.post: Won the fiddle contest. Still holding the ribbon.

milestones.text: tuned the fiddle by ear for the first time
milestones.post: Tuned it by ear. Didn't even need help.

milestones.text: played the fiddle at the village feast and nobody complained
milestones.post: Fiddled at the feast. Zero complaints.

milestones.text: played fiddle at the saloon's Saturday dance
milestones.post: Saturday dance fiddler. That's me now.

milestones.text: played open strings on the cello with a clean, steady sound
milestones.post: Open strings. Deep and steady. Happy.

milestones.text: played the prelude from Bach's first cello suite slowly but whole
milestones.post: Bach, slowly. But all of it.

milestones.text: learned to shift up the neck without missing the note
milestones.post: Shifted and landed it. Cello acrobatics.

milestones.text: played the cello part in a string quartet rehearsal
milestones.post: Quartet rehearsal. Cello holds it all together.

milestones.text: played The Swan at a small concert
milestones.post: The Swan. Some people closed their eyes. Good sign.

milestones.text: played a full cello sonata at a recital
milestones.post: A whole sonata. Arms tired, heart full.

milestones.text: carried the cello to a lesson without bumping a single doorframe
milestones.post: The cello and I arrived unharmed. A first.

milestones.text: learned their first four chords on the ukulele
milestones.post: Four chords on the uke. Unstoppable.

milestones.text: strummed a whole ukulele song badly but cheerfully
milestones.post: Bad but cheerful. Very ukulele.

milestones.text: played the ukulele at a picnic and got everyone singing
milestones.post: Picnic singalong. The uke did its job.

milestones.text: learned a fancy ukulele strum with a triplet in it
milestones.post: Triplet strum. My wrist is very impressed.

milestones.text: played a ukulele set at a little local show
milestones.post: Little uke, big stage. Okay, medium stage.

milestones.text: played a ukulele solo that made the room go quiet
milestones.post: Silenced a room with a ukulele. Who knew.

milestones.text: strummed the ukulele through a whole night of dance tunes
milestones.post: Dance tunes all night on the uke. Fingers buzzing.

milestones.text: played a basic rock beat for a whole minute without losing it
milestones.post: Boom, tap, boom-boom tap. For a minute!

milestones.text: kept their sticks in hand for a whole practice
milestones.post: Didn't drop a stick once. Pro move.

milestones.text: played their first drum fill and landed back on the beat
milestones.post: Fill and back on the one. Chef's kiss.

milestones.text: drummed through a full rehearsal with a band
milestones.post: Full band rehearsal on drums. Loud and glorious.

milestones.text: drummed a whole gig at a local bar's music night
milestones.post: Drummed a whole gig. Ears ringing, grinning.

milestones.text: played a drum solo that got a standing cheer
milestones.post: Drum solo. Crowd went up. I went up.

milestones.text: played along to a whole song on the playlist without stopping
milestones.post: Drummed along to a whole song. Neighbours endured.

milestones.text: learned their first banjo roll
milestones.post: One banjo roll. Many to go.

milestones.text: played a whole banjo tune at a steady speed
milestones.post: Banjo tune, steady speed. Toe tapping guaranteed.

milestones.text: played banjo with a fiddler and kept up the whole time
milestones.post: Kept up with the fiddler. Banjo honour intact.

milestones.text: played banjo at a dance and got the whole room up dancing
milestones.post: Banjo got them dancing. My job is done.

milestones.text: won the banjo prize at the county fair
milestones.post: Banjo prize, county fair. Ribbon on the wall.

milestones.text: tuned the banjo and kept it tuned for a whole tune
milestones.post: Stayed in tune for a whole song. Banjo miracle.

milestones.text: played banjo in a jazz band's rehearsal
milestones.post: Banjo in a jazz band. Plinky and proud.

milestones.text: learned to pluck the lute without catching the wrong course
milestones.post: Plucked the right strings. Lute progress.

milestones.text: tuned all the lute's strings in one sitting
milestones.post: All courses in tune. Took an hour.

milestones.text: played a simple ballad on the lute for the household
milestones.post: Lute ballad for the household. They hummed along.

milestones.text: accompanied a singer on the lute at the evening meal
milestones.post: Played lute for a singer at supper. Lovely evening.

milestones.text: played the lute in the great hall at a feast
milestones.post: Lute at the feast. The lord nodded. Probably good.

milestones.text: was asked to play the lute for a visiting noble's arrival
milestones.post: Played for a noble's arrival. Hands steady, just.

milestones.text: played a lute tune that made the forest go quiet
milestones.post: Even the birds stopped to listen. Or they were shocked.

milestones.text: got a clear note out of the flute on the first breath
milestones.post: A real note! No hissing!

milestones.text: held a steady note on the flute for a whole count of ten
milestones.post: Ten counts of one note. Breath of steel.

milestones.text: played a simple flute melody all the way through
milestones.post: One whole tune on the flute. Light-headed but proud.

milestones.text: played flute trills cleanly in a lively tune
milestones.post: Trills on the flute. Twinkly.

milestones.text: played flute with a small ensemble at a gathering
milestones.post: Flute in the ensemble. My part was audible. Good.

milestones.text: played the flute solo at the season's big celebration
milestones.post: The flute solo was mine. The hall was quiet for it.

milestones.text: played a wooden flute tune at the village green
milestones.post: Wooden flute on the green. Children followed me.

milestones.text: played flute in the town band for the first time
milestones.post: Town band flautist. There's a hat.

milestones.text: mixed two songs together without a clash
milestones.post: Two songs, one mix, no train wreck.

milestones.text: built their first DJ set playlist
milestones.post: First set planned. Thirty tracks, no idea what I'm doing.

milestones.text: beatmatched two tracks by ear
milestones.post: Beatmatched by ear. Felt like a wizard.

milestones.text: spun records for two hours at a friend's birthday party
milestones.post: Two hours of a friend's party. Dancefloor never emptied.

milestones.text: played a set at a local club's early slot
milestones.post: Early slot at the club. Ten people. They danced.

milestones.text: headlined a night at a local venue
milestones.post: Headlined. My name on the poster. Shaking.

milestones.text: kept a dancefloor going through a whole hour of their set
milestones.post: Full hour, full dancefloor. Mine.

milestones.text: uploaded their first mix online and people listened
milestones.post: Mix uploaded. People actually listened. Surreal.

sessions.text: Worked on the same tricky passage for most of an hour.
Played through some old favourites just for fun.

Practised scales until they stopped being boring.
Tried a new piece and got through the first page.
Played slowly, then a bit faster, then slowly again.
Hummed the melody all evening afterwards.
Kept time by tapping a foot the whole session.
Took a long break in the middle and came back fresh.
Played quietly so as not to wake anyone.
Ended the session on the one song they know best.
Spent a while making up little tunes.
Went back over last week's lesson.
Played until their fingers asked for a rest.
Noted down a phrase to work on tomorrow.
Recorded a bit of practice on their phone to listen back.
Played along with a favourite record.
Practised a new chord change over and over.
Worked on keeping the bow straight.
Practised one tricky fill again and again.
